# Phase 2 — Multi-harness (Gemini)

[GENESIS §14 Phase 2](GENESIS.md). Adds Gemini support and cross-harness polish.

Exit criteria (from GENESIS §14):

- Parity for all three harnesses; `maru profile use work` activates all three correctly on all three OSes.
- Carve-out matrix in `maru doctor` matches §7.4.
